أرتفع (form VIII)
# أَرْتَفِعُ (ʔartafiʕu) /ʔar.ta.fi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَفَعَ (irtafaʕa)
# أَرْتَفِعَ (ʔartafiʕa) /ʔar.ta.fi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَفَعَ (irtafaʕa)
# أَرْتَفِعْ (ʔartafiʕ) /ʔar.ta.fiʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَفَعَ (irtafaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
